# Regional Hiring Strategy - Austin Metro

## Workforce Overview
- Total Workforce: 1,182,500
- Top Sector: Computer and mathematical science occupations (12.4%, 145,820 workers)
- Median Salary Range: $32,500 - $115,200

## Strategic Recommendations
1. Prioritize local residency for community alignment and cost reduction
2. Focus recruitment on high-growth sectors: Computer/Math, Management, Business/Financial
3. External candidates only for niche roles lacking local expertise
4. Leverage strong local retention sentiment in hiring messaging

## Data Sources
- BLS OES 2023 (Occupation Data)
- Regional Industry Outlook 2024 (Industry Sentiment)
